text.p: Goodrich Petroleum Corp said it has agreed to acquire the oil and natural gas properties of La/Cal Energy Partners II and is in final negotiations to acquire other properties from working interest owners.

The interests being acquired are located in seven separate fields in South Louisiana and East Texas and include proved reserves of some 1,718,000 barrels of oil and 3.91 billion cubic feet of natural gas, Goodrich said.
The purchase price of $17,446,695 is subject to adjustment.
It consists of $2 million in cash, $7.5 million in shares of a newly designated series of Goodrich convertible preferred and the assumption of $7,946,695 in debt, the company said.

The 750,000 preferred shares will be convertible into Goodrich common at a conversion premium of 25 percent. The new series will be junior to the company's existing Series A Preferred, will be entitled to an 8.25 percent annual dividend and will become redeemable by the company after 4 years.
Subject to receipt of the necessary approvals, Goodrich anticipates closing the transaction during the fourth quarter.

It said the proposed transactions were negotiated on behalf of Goodrich by a special committee of outside directors because the La/Cal II partners and working interest owners include certain members of the company's senior management and board.

The closings are is subject to the approval of the parties of La/Cal II and the execution of definitive agreements with the working interest owners. The closing is also contingent upon the approval of Goodrich's stockholders of the issuance of the shares of preferred stock.
